body: claimed: Antigravity (len) · 2026-11-15T14:38Z · branch mkinney:issue/1901-docs-operation-icons · plan: add Zola icon shortcode, synced site/static/icons + LICENSES notice, operation/control icons in guide pages, and site+UI drift pins

Stopped at Step 7 because `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` failed twice on `upstream/main` (`6f8b309d`) due to pre-existing issue #1909 (open fix PR #1912):

- `detect_holes_note_tests::detect_holes_on_a_bore_op_with_only_a_wide_hole_is_refused` (`crates/ui/src/detect_holes_note_tests.rs:108`: assertion `left == right` failed, `left: 1`, `right: 0`)
- `detect_holes_note_tests::detect_holes_on_a_bore_op_stores_the_small_hole_and_names_the_wide_one` (`crates/ui/src/detect_holes_note_tests.rs:97`: assertion `left == right` failed, `left: 2`, `right: 1`)

Checks on the #1901 work:
- Pin test `egui_app::tests::op_icon_table::docs_site_icons_match_app_table_and_operations`: red before fix, green after fix (`op_icon_table` 6 passed, 0 failed).
- Mutation checks (red then restored green): renaming `Adaptive2D` icon stem in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/icons.rs`, reverting `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md` to `upstream/main`, and reverting `site/templates/base.html` to `upstream/main`.
- Quick gate suites: `ui:boundary` (3/3), `ui:boundary_picks` (6/6), `ui:sinker_setup` (2/2), `ui:theme_files` (14/14), and 814 of 816 non-ignored `camcraft-ui` lib tests passed; 2 failed on the #1909 bore detect-holes tests above.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed cleanly (0 warnings).
- Not exercised locally: `zola build` and `site/tests/` (`test_guide_icons.py`, `test_guide_navigation.py`, `test_operation_reference.py`) because `zola` is not installed in the runner and `curl` / `python3` commands were blocked here.

Held work is committed and pushed on `mkinney:issue/1901-docs-operation-icons` (`7d62d830`, including `docs/decisions/1901-docs-operation-icons.md`, `site/templates/shortcodes/icon.html`, 92 UI PNGs + `LICENSES.txt` under `site/static/icons/`, dark-mode CSS in `site/static/style.css`, all 44 operation headings, inline control/tree/badge/tab icons across the user guide, and Rust + Python pin tests).

Overlaps: PR #1798 touches `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/op_icon_table.rs` (different function: `tree_rows_badges_and_actions_are_svg_mastered`, plus `icons.rs`). Removing `claimed` so the work can be merged with `main` and PR'd once #1912 lands and `zola build` / `site/tests` pass.
